name: @voice-kit/handsfree
description: voice-kit: the hands-free session. On the wake word a short soft chime, then it listens until a silence of a set length and hands the words to the app; a follow-up window with no wake word; a lower chime as it closes; open and close hooks so the app can pause and resume its sound. A plain state machine over injected ports (the wake, the app's listen, the chimes, the page's visibility) and an injected clock. No React.
